title: Choose your keyboard
lines: Choose your keyboard in Settings, under Keys: QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, Colemak-DH or Workman.
Each key does the same thing in the same place on every keyboard (on AZERTY you walk with Z, Q, S and D), and the game shows it as your keyboard prints it.

more.head: In the Works
points: Shift and = zooms in, as + on the number pad does. = alone picks the 12th tool.
